values: 一名擅长聚集敌人的游侠，擅长搭配拥有范围效果的友军。
A Rogue skilled at attracting enemies and working well with allies who can deal AoE damage.
By the title of the swordsman!
每一步的修行都不可或缺
No step of practice can be missed!
May the wind and frost unite as one!
I have yet to reach... my... full... potential...
以锋刃明志，我会秉承剑之道。
The razor point will show that I walk the path of the blade.
这柄剑，希望它能斩断一切。
I hope this sword can cleave anything in its way!
寒冰与凛风交织的剑刃所向披靡。
Frozen water and frigid wind combine with my keen blade to sweep all before it!
对一个远离故土的游子来说，这是最好的礼物。
For one who has wandered far from home, this is the finest gift.
谢谢，我会珍惜这份礼物。
Many thanks, I will cherish this.
寒霜与凛风交织的剑刃，寄托着丛林的希望。
The sharp sword made of harsh frost and biting wind bears the hope of the jungle.
“剑”诞生的意义，就是守卫丛林的子民。
A sword is meant to protect the forest folks.
完成剧情任务“翡绿的净化”特定环节获得。
Complete Story Quest - Turn a New Leaf
要是绿植多一些就好了
It would be great if there were more plants around.
Winter Carnival... time to head back to Lunadorf.
Want to go watch the fireworks?
埃隆双剑中其中一把是在薄暮丛林中打造而成的，使用魔法剑的能力则是在游历时习得的。
One of Eironn's twin blades was forged in the Dark Forest, and he only learned to wield its power throughout the course of his travels.
月湖村周围的一块名贵草药田里，有一小块比周围的矮，据达赫妮婆婆说，那是埃隆小时候不小心砍断的。

In the fields of precious herbs surrounding Lunadorf, there is a small patch that grows shorter than any of those around it. Granny Dahnie says that it was accidentally cut short by Eironn in his youth.
埃隆曾带着奄奄一息的受伤的鸟兽来到流荧树前，神奇的是，它们的伤势真能在树前奇迹般好转。
Eironn would bring dying animals before the Lucent Tree, where their wounds would miraculously begin to heal.
薄暮丛林与外界鲜少交流。埃隆刚开始游历时，曾试图用叶子作为货币付旅费。

The Dark Forest maintains little contact with the outside world. At the start of his journey, Eironn once tried to pay for his expenses with leaves. "This is a leaf! It's special!" He exclaimed as he tried to explain its value to a caravan trader.
圣石镇的餐馆中，至今仍流传着老板娘见一个身无分文的绿裔青年过于俊美，头脑一热就为其免单的轶事。

To this day, there is a well-known anecdote in the eateries of Holistone. It is the story of a handsome yet penniless Wilder and how a certain proprietress offered him a free meal simply because of his good looks.
埃隆的双剑中，其中一把并非实体，而是魔法汇聚而成的造物，随时都能改变形状。
One of Eironn's twin blades lacks a physical form and is actually composed of concentrated magical energy that can freely change its shape.
埃隆从小不离身的剑其实并未开刃，在不懂剑术的人手中毫无威力，在埃隆的手中却所向披靡。
The blade that Eironn has kept at his side since childhood is not actually sharpened, making it useless in anyone else's hands. In his hands, however, Eiron becomes unstoppable.
埃隆会时刻保持自己的衣摆没有一丝褶皱，却不会挥手赶走栖身于手臂上的小鸟。
Eironn strives to keep his clothing free of wrinkles at all times. However, he refuses to shake off any birds that perch on his shoulders.
埃隆游历时，连耀光王都的居民都惊叹于这位绿裔青年的礼数之周正，装扮之别致，还掀起了一股鹿角头饰的风潮。

During his travels, even the citizens of the Lightbearer capital were taken aback by Eironn's courteous demeanor. His unique Wilder appearance also started a trend of wearing antlers among the city's youthful elite.
在薄暮丛林众人的眼里，埃隆几乎没有做不到的事——除了莱卡。她知道埃隆所有不擅长处理的日常事务。
In the eyes of the Dark Forest's denizens, there is nothing that Eironn cannot do. Only Lyca is aware of his greatest shortcoming: his inability to handle daily chores.
……发生了这么多事，今后丛林会走向怎样的方向呢？
...With so much happening, what will be the fate of the forest?
Winter Carnival... time to head back to Lunadorf.
Want to go watch the fireworks?
新生的树该怎么照顾呢。
How does one take care of a newborn tree?
说起来，我们三个真是难得聚在一起。
It's rare for the three of us to get together!
莱卡 & 埃隆 & 帕瑞莎
卡夫拉，你的剑术十分了得。
埃隆 & 卡夫拉 & 漫漫
诸位，你们有没有觉得月影乡的人对外面有一些……奇怪的认知？
Don't you feel that the residents of Ivoryshade have some strange ideas about the outside world?
哎呀，麻烦事终于结束了。你们听，这一路东奔西走，连喝水的时间都没有，我嗓音都沙哑了……
Finally, I can take a break. We've been running around all this time, and I didn't even have the time to get a drink of water. I'm so parched...
